mapper.sql: select r.registration_id, r.student_id, r.semester_id, r.register_status, r.register_time, r.register_by, r.channel, r.defer_reason, r.remark, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, s.student_no, s.student_name, s.student_status, c.class_name, d.dept_name, sem.semester_name from sam_registration r join sam_student s on r.student_id = s.student_id left join brm_class c on s.class_id = c.class_id left join brm_department d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id left join brm_semester sem on r.semester_id = sem.semester_id
mapper.insert:
insert into sam_registration
student_id, semester_id, register_status, register_time, register_by, channel, defer_reason, remark, create_by, create_time,
#{studentId}, #{semesterId}, #{registerStatus}, #{registerTime}, #{registerBy}, #{channel}, #{deferReason}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{createTime},
mapper.delete: delete from sam_registration where registration_id in #{registrationId}
mapper.insert: insert into sam_registration (student_id, semester_id, register_status, create_by, create_time) select s.student_id, #{semesterId}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate() from sam_student s where s.student_status = '0' and not exists ( select 1 from sam_registration r where r.student_id = s.student_id and r.semester_id = #{semesterId} )
mapper.select: select count(1) from sam_registration where semester_id = #{semesterId} and register_status = '0'

select count(1) as total, sum(case when register_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as registered, sum(case when register_status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as deferred, sum(case when register_status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as unregistered from sam_registration where semester_id = #{semesterId}

select ifnull(d.dept_name, '未分配院系') as deptName, count(1) as total, sum(case when r.register_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as registered, sum(case when r.register_status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as deferred, sum(case when r.register_status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as unregistered, round(sum(case when r.register_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / count(1), 2) as registerRate from sam_registration r join sam_student s on r.student_id = s.student_id left join brm_department d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id where r.semester_id = #{semesterId} group by d.dept_name order by registerRate desc, total desc
select semester_id from brm_semester where status = '0' order by (start_date <= curdate() and end_date >= curdate()) desc, semester_id desc limit 1
